_meta.note: Ready-made DSL rules you can install with `rules_presets_load`. All idempotent via UNIQUE(name).
_meta.source: Not research-derived: thresholds (30% funding, |z|>2σ, $50M liquidations/60min, |imbalance|>0.7) are starting-point values chosen by the model from general crypto-derivatives knowledge, NOT backtested or sourced from a specific research artifact. BACKLOG 3.2 only listed signal categories (funding extremes, liquidation cascades, OI+price divergences, …) — the exact numbers here are placeholders.
_meta.action_required: Tune every threshold against your own history (e.g. via event_study + funding_zscore + liquidations_summary) before relying on these in production. Treat the presets as a template, not a signal library.

presets.name: preset_btc_funding_hot_binance
presets.message: Binance BTC funding {value_pct:+.2f}%/yr > 30% — perp is paying longs too much; consider short-perp carry

presets.name: preset_btc_funding_crush_binance
presets.message: Binance BTC funding {value_pct:+.2f}%/yr < -20% — perp is paying shorts; long-perp carry window

presets.name: preset_btc_funding_extreme_zscore
presets.message: Binance BTC funding is {value:+.2f}σ from the 14d mean — mean-reversion setup

presets.name: preset_hl_funding_crypto_carry
presets.message: HL BTC pays {value_pct:+.2f}%/yr while Deribit is cheap — short-HL / long-Deribit crypto-carry

presets.name: preset_btc_liquidation_cascade
presets.message: Binance BTCUSDT liquidations > $50M in last 60 min — cascade in progress

presets.name: preset_btc_liq_imbalance_shorts_squeezed
presets.message: Shorts dominating BTC liquidations (imbalance {value:+.2f}) — upside squeeze

presets.name: preset_btc_liq_imbalance_longs_flushed
presets.message: Longs being flushed in BTC (imbalance {value:+.2f}) — downside cascade
